events.text: Black-sailed boats raid the river trade. Merchants will pay well for guards.

effects.log: Two quiet weeks and one very loud night. (+15 taels)
You hear of the raids at the teahouse.

events.text: Pirates board the ferry you are on.

ok.log: Three pirates go into the river. The rest flee.

effects.log: The pirates take silver and leave. Nobody is hurt.

events.text: The pirate captain is rumoured to be a former sect disciple, cast out for a crime he did not commit.

effects.log: You find the old records. Perhaps someone will listen.
Pirates are pirates.

events.text: A river village begs for help: the pirates take their fish every week.

effects.log: The next raid meets thirty angry fishermen.

choices.text: Wait for the raid and fight

effects.log: The pirates learn to avoid this village.

events.text: A fight on a rocking deck: every step could send you into the river.

ok.log: You dance across the deck like a heron.

fail.log: You end up in the river. You swim back, soaked and furious.

effects.log: Solid ground, smart choice.

events.text: The pirates have taken a merchant's son for ransom.

ok.log: In and out without a sound. The merchant weeps.

fail.log: You are spotted and fight your way out, with the boy.

effects.log: The boy comes home. The pirates grow bolder.

events.text: The river navy finally arrives. The admiral wants local fighters.

effects.log: A week on the river. The pirates are broken.
You know every inlet. They are impressed.

events.text: A captured pirate offers to tell where the loot is buried in exchange for his freedom.

effects.log: The law is the law.
The loot is real. So is your guilt. (+20 taels)

events.text: You and your friends play pirates on a raft in the pond.

effects.log: You sink. Captains go down with the ship.
You capture everyone. Justice.

events.text: A hidden cove with the charred wreck of a pirate boat.

ok.log: A strongbox under the hull. (+18 taels)

choices.text: Leave a warning mark for other boats

effects.log: Travellers will know to beware.

events.text: The boatmen sing a song about a hero who beat the river pirates. The hero sounds like you.

effects.log: The song gets a new verse.
The boatmen boo. Songs are not for facts.

events.text: With the pirates gone, the river is busy again. Merchants thank those who helped.

effects.log: A bolt of silk and warm thanks. (+8 taels)

choices.text: Ask them to lower prices for the poor

effects.log: Some do.
